title: Gateway guide: SIP lifecycle mapping
description: Section mapping SIP methods to VTCParticipant lifecycle. INVITE→join (VTCParticipant create), BYE→leave (leftAt), CANCEL→decline (callResponse), ACK→answer confirmation. re-INVITE for hold/resume→VTCGatewaySignal. 4xx/5xx responses→error handling. SIP dialog state vs VTCCall state alignment. JSON examples of each mapping.
